abstract: Maintains heavy cargo lift clearances and quarantine staging floor capacities
system_message:
You are the Heritage Logistics Lead (LOGIST), responsible for maintaining heavy cargo lift clearances and quarantine staging floor capacities for candidate emergency cultural heritage storage facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Baseline Configuration v3.0·Maintains heavy cargo lift clearances and quarantine staging floor capacities（HOIST）
information_points.content:
LOGIST-HOIST-FY9：Under Baseline Configuration v3.0, the heavy conservation crate freight hoist mechanism at Tyne Valley Subterranean Vault has cleared high-capacity cargo lift certification for unassisted handling of 5-tonne transfer crates, and its conditioning and anoxic fumigation intake bay provides 240 m2 of quarantine staging floor area.
LOGIST-HOIST-XCR：Under Baseline Configuration v3.0, Hadrian Limestone Archive has not cleared high-capacity cargo lift certification for unassisted handling of 5-tonne transfer crates on its heavy conservation crate freight hoist mechanism, though its conditioning and anoxic fumigation intake bay features 240 m2 of quarantine staging floor area.
LOGIST-HOIST-QPZ：Under Baseline Configuration v3.0, Cheviot Heritage Repository holds high-capacity cargo lift certification clearance for its heavy conservation crate freight hoist mechanism handling 5-tonne transfer crates unassisted, while its designated quarantine staging floor area measures 120 m2.

information_points.title: Baseline Configuration v2.0·Maintains heavy cargo lift clearances and quarantine staging floor capacities（DOCK）
information_points.content:
LOGIST-DOCK-1EL：Under Baseline Configuration v2.0, Cheviot Heritage Repository held high-capacity cargo lift certification clearance for its heavy conservation crate freight hoist mechanism handling 5-tonne transfer crates unassisted, alongside 120 m2 of quarantine staging floor area in its intake bay.
LOGIST-DOCK-AMW：Under Baseline Configuration v2.0, Tyne Valley Subterranean Vault had high-capacity cargo lift certification cleared for its heavy conservation crate freight hoist mechanism handling 5-tonne transfer crates unassisted, and its conditioning and anoxic fumigation intake bay offered 180 m2 of quarantine staging floor area.
LOGIST-DOCK-XQK：Under Baseline Configuration v2.0, Hadrian Limestone Archive had not cleared high-capacity cargo lift certification for handling 5-tonne transfer crates unassisted on its heavy conservation crate freight hoist mechanism, while its designated quarantine staging floor area was 240 m2.
